rationale: Review of the Git FAQ frontend MR (commit 9c791db3e, origin/main..HEAD, 15 files +409/-12). Registers INDEX_TYPES.GIT_FAQ end-to-end: type constant, humanize()/getIndexTypeDisplay() label 'Git FAQ', getFullIndexType/getIndexTypeCode/isGitFaqIndex mapping to backend 'knowledge_base_git_faq', DataSourceTypeIcon, a new IndexTypeFaq form (Repository Link/Branch/FAQ Path/Files Filter, gated on the Git integration type), Yup validation requiring faqPath as a relative path, create/update wiring (createKBIndexGitFaq, createOrUpdateGitFaqIndex) that only sends source fields (link/branch/faq_path/files_filter/setting_id) when full_reindex is implied by hasSourceChanged or the reindex checkbox -- matching the backend's 'source fields require full_reindex=true' contract reviewed in the backend MR. FilesFilterField was made configurable via optional props with defaults equal to its prior hardcoded strings; confirmed its two other callers (IndexTypeGit, IndexTypeSvn) pass only control/errors, so they render byte-identical text -- no regression. All 8 new/touched tests pass (faqIndexHelpers.test.ts, DataSourceDetails.test.tsx), `tsc --noEmit` is clean, and eslint on every changed file reports zero issues (one harmless react-version config warning, pre-existing). One non-blocking observation: src/store/dataSources.ts's health-check payload builder now spreads `options.git_url` twice (a new line before the pre-existing one) -- functionally inert (same key, same value) but redundant; recommend deleting the duplicate in a follow-up, not blocking this MR.

business_review.item: UI exposes the FAQ path input only when the Git FAQ index type is selected
business_review.notes: DataSourceForm.tsx renders IndexTypeField.Faq only when field.value === INDEX_TYPES.GIT_FAQ; verified live in the running app (screenshots 02/03/04).

business_review.item: Changing FAQ options in the UI correctly configures the backend payload
business_review.notes: createOrUpdateGitFaqIndex builds { link, branch, faq_path, files_filter, setting_id, embedding_model, cron_expression } matching IndexKnowledgeBaseGitFaqRequest; update path gates source fields behind full_reindex via hasSourceChanged, matching the backend's 422-without-full_reindex contract verified in the backend review.

business_review.item: No regression for other datasource types
business_review.notes: FilesFilterField's new optional props default to the original hardcoded label/tooltip/placeholder; IndexTypeGit and IndexTypeSvn (its only other callers) pass no new props, so their rendered output is unchanged. New Yup rules and icon/display-label branches are additive (gated on INDEX_TYPES.GIT_FAQ), not modifying existing type branches.

business_review.item: Datasource type registered in FE constants/enum/labels for display, detail view, and edit-mode defaults
business_review.notes: INDEX_TYPES.GIT_FAQ added; DataSourceTypeIcon, DataSourceDetails (shows link/branch/faq_path), useEditPopupForm defaults (faqPath: defaults?.faq_path ?? 'faq') all wired.

standards_review.notes: Commit 'EPMCDME-11696: Add Git FAQ datasource UI' uses TICKET-ID: prefix; branch EPMCDME-11696_git-faq-datasource follows convention.
tsc --noEmit clean; eslint clean on every changed file; new files carry the Apache-2.0 header; 8/8 relevant tests pass.

No new secret handling; FAQ integration reuses the existing Git credential/integration flow (IntegrationSection with datasourceType=INDEX_TYPES.GIT); no new user-input reaches an unsafe sink (faqPath is validated client-side and re-validated server-side per the backend review).
